in_hebrew.name: Alie
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Gentle, noble, otherworldly
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Alie הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word αλειπω (aleipo), meaning 'to wipe away, soothe, or console'. In ancient Greece, this name was associated with the goddesses Hygieia and Aphrodite, who offered healing, compassion, and love. In Christianity, Alie may symbolize the comforting presence of the Holy Spirit.
